title: Athens Undergraduate Economics Competition 2027
summary: Submit original undergraduate economics research for academic review and presentation.

prize.description: Academic review, feedback, presentation and awards; cash amount not established.

notes: Abstract up to 1,000 words, academic record, biography and faculty recommendation required. Free participation.
Paper due 31 May 2027; Athens presentations 28–29 June. Selected entrants arrange and fund travel / accommodation.
